proofBoundary: This closes which members of the already-complete +0x1610 writer denominator have a constant byte-0 value. It proves five writer values exactly (0/1) and narrows the primary-lightmap frontier to the two packed builders 0x009A7D3F and 0x009A7DD3. It does not claim every low-byte value 0..255 is runtime-reachable, identify the lightmap caller path, order all writers at runtime, map numeric bytes to API sampler enums, or prove a historical executable build.
